textures.name: weathered-masonry
textures.prompt: Generate an original photorealistic square seamlessly tileable PBR diffuse/albedo texture, not a scene: ancient dark cool grey limestone block masonry for the interior of a monumental abandoned European palace. Large hand-dressed irregular rectangular stones in staggered horizontal courses, subtle shallow narrow mortar joints, chipped corners, small pits and fine mineral grain, water worn edges, restrained damp verdigris traces in crevices, variations charcoal to muted warm slate. Orthographic perpendicular surface capture, completely flat even diffuse lighting, no directional shadows, no highlights, no objects, no lettering, no frame. Museum-quality architectural material scan appearance. Natural, detailed and premium. Fill entire square; truly seamless on all four edges. Deliver one diffuse material only.

No beige saturated sandstone, no orange, no marble gloss. Orthographic close surface scan, perfectly even diffuse illumination, no baked shadows or directional light. High-end natural stone material. Entire image is only material, no objects, no text, no border. Seamless in both axes, square.
